Package com.codedstream.otterstream.rules.spi

Interface RuleEngine

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultRuleEngine
public interface RuleEngine
Evaluates InferenceResults against a RuleSet, producing Decisions.

This is the extension point for the Rule Engine feature: YamlRuleEngine (the default, in this same module) is one implementation; a project can supply its own by implementing this interface directly — the standard/default path is YAML, but a hand-written class is fully supported and is exactly this interface.

Implementations must be safe for concurrent use — evaluate/evaluateBatch are expected to sit on or near the inference hot path (see otter-stream-rules/ARCHITECTURE.md performance notes), so implementations should avoid locking across an entire rule set evaluation; YamlRuleEngine uses per-rule atomic counters for metrics specifically to avoid that.

0.1.0

    • evaluate

      Decision evaluate(InferenceResult inferenceResult, Map<String,Object> context) throws RuleEvaluationException
      Evaluates one inference result. Mode (SINGLE vs MULTIPLE matches) is governed by RuleSet.evaluationMode(), not a parameter here — it's a property of the rule set, not of an individual call.
      Parameters:
      inferenceResult - the inference result to evaluate
      context - additional fields to make available to rule conditions beyond what's in inferenceResult itself (e.g. request-scoped metadata); may be empty
      Returns:
      the resulting decision — Decision.unflagged(long) if no rule matched
      Throws:
      RuleEvaluationException - if a rule's condition fails to evaluate

    • evaluateBatch

      List<Decision> evaluateBatch(List<InferenceResult> inferenceResults, Map<String,Object> context) throws RuleEvaluationException
      Evaluates a batch of inference results — the "batch" flagging mode. Implementations may parallelize this (the default YamlRuleEngine does, above a configurable batch-size threshold) since each result's evaluation is independent.
      Parameters:
      inferenceResults - the inference results to evaluate, in order
      context - shared context applied to every result in the batch
      Returns:
      one decision per input result, same order
      Throws:
      RuleEvaluationException - if any result's evaluation fails
